title: 'UAP hedge' tweet responding to FT Alphaville article on financial risks of UAP disclosure

tellings.quote: like I think I have a I had like a semi- tongue-in-cheek tweet like four or five years ago that's like, "What's your UAP hedge hashtag Bitcoin?" It was a response to this uh, like FT alpha article is talking about like financial stability risks associated with uh, UAPs disclosure, right?

plain: A commentator named Matthew Pines says that around 2020 or 2021 he posted a half-joking tweet asking "What's your UAP hedge?" with the hashtag Bitcoin. UAP means unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's term for UFOs, and he says the tweet answered an article on FT Alphaville, a finance blog of the Financial Times newspaper, about risks to financial stability if the government disclosed what it knows about them. The point is that some people take seriously that such disclosure could shake markets.
